en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large Art Deco department store building dominating a city square. The building has tall vertical lines, two tower-like structures, and the word "KARSTADT" on the main tower. Flags line the roof, and shops with awnings front the street. A subway entrance marked with a large "U" is visible in the square. Printed caption text along the bottom identifies the location as Berlin-Neukölln and the Hermannplatz square with the Karstadt department store.
